# Port without a fork

Inspect the pinned upstream image, API docs and frontend source; retain its license and attribution. Add wizard.md, Runtipi config/compose and a skill in the upstream repo or a wrapper. Put an MCP front over documented upstream API operations; all calls use the single Wizard gateway. A wrapper can point view.source at an upstream repo pinned to a tag/commit, while API alone permits a new screen. Server-rendered HTML supports overlay/new API screens; verify architecture rather than guessing.

Check with approved rules plus explicit proposal mode. Keep copied image digest/source/license and narrow tool schemas. A source-only wrapper is not an installed port. The first bounded candidate demonstrates new apps only; a real upstream port is a separate test, with no claimed pass here.
